root: ^Lenny: Well, a thief stealing from thieves? You’d fit right in with our merry band of misfits—
^too bad we’re full up. Hands off that chest. The girl’s worth more than your life.
^You're behind all this? Good. Taking out the head of the snake should fix things.
^Her sister’s worried... can you let her go?
^This chest is yours? Sorry... I was just looking for a cozy nap inside.

c-0: ^Lenny: Spoken like a true fool. Your blood’ll make a fine stain on my greataxe.
c-1: ^Lenny: Reason with a thief? You’re dreaming, kid. This won’t end well for you.
c-2: ^Lenny: A joker, huh? Plenty of sleep’s coming for you when my axe splits you in two.
